title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Default rotation validated against full Job Bank detail pages. Scores measure technical and domain fit only; ineligible arrangements are excluded before scoring.
latest_update: Rechecked September 19, 2026 — no eligible target-family postings this run.

notes_sections.heading: Geographic exclusions
items: DevOps Engineer — Bluth Company (Toronto, ON, Permanent, $80,000–$140,000/year, posted September 8): confirmed On site in the Job Bank listing itself. Toronto is outside the reachable-city list. View posting.

DevOps Engineer — LYNKED Inc. (London, ON, Permanent, $58,000–$69,000/year, posted September 15): confirmed On site. London is outside the reachable-city list; pay is also well below the $100k FTE floor. View posting.
DevOps Engineer — InfoTrack Canada (Toronto, ON, $130,000–$150,000/year, posted August 31): tagged Hybrid, but Toronto is outside the reachable-city list regardless of office cadence. View posting.

Cloud Engineer — Lancesoft (Montréal, QC, contract, $65.52–$80.00/hour, posted August 27): real Platform/Cloud center of gravity (hybrid connectivity, cloud governance, platform observability) but the posting states Day-1 onboarding with in-office presence 3x/week — exceeds the 2-day/week Montréal cap in this skill's geography rule. A different Lancesoft SRE posting (job ID 50107335) was rejected 2026-08-19 per applications.md; this is a distinct posting at the same employer, not a duplicate. View posting.

DevOps/Cloud Engineer, Senior — Source Code (Toronto, ON, contract, $93.60/hour, posted September 14): 3 days/week onsite at a named Toronto office address. Toronto is outside the reachable-city list. View posting.
Cloud Engineer — Source Code (Toronto, ON, contract, $90.37/hour, posted September 14): 5 days/week onsite at a named Toronto office address. Toronto is outside the reachable-city list. View posting.

notes_sections.heading: Unrelated-role exclusion
items: "DevOps Engineer" — Ides Canada Inc. (Stouffville, ON, posted September 18): Job Bank's occupation-code match is wrong — the actual linked posting is for a Mechatronics Engineer role at Scentroid, unrelated to DevOps/SRE/Platform work. Not scored.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Ran the default 3-query rotation only (DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer), per SKILL.md — Platform Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, and DevSecOps Engineer are deliberately excluded from the default rotation due to historically unrelated occupation-code matches.
Site Reliability Engineer returned zero results this run.
DevOps Engineer returned 4 results, Cloud Engineer returned 3 — all 7 reviewed and validated against full detail pages; none were eligible after the geography and role-relevance gates.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred. All retrieval was read-only, via direct HTTP.
